text:
alejandra: hi! first week here. i need staging Console admin + feature-flag-edit so i can run onboarding experiments. my okta shows only console-view. who do i poke?

 tom: welcome! file an IT Access request for 'Console (Staging) - Admin' and check the 'feature-flag-edit' box. include your manager and okta email. i can sponsor the request.

 alejandra: okta: alejandra.p@redwood.dev. manager: tom. emp id: 74123. filing now.

 access-bot: Request REQ-12011 created by alejandra. Roles requested: console-staging-admin, feature-flag-edit. Status: Pending manager approval.

 tom: approved.

 access-bot: REQ-12011 approved by tom. Assigned to it-oncall. Group propagation ETA 10-20m.

 mike: quick FYI: feature-flag-edit lets you modify flags, but sandbox segments are gated by a separate 'flag-sandbox' role on the request. if you want isolated experiments request that too. docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/flags-sandbox (internal).

 alejandra: saw the staging-admin group after ~11m but flags still read-only.

 access-bot: REQ-12011 updated: added missing role 'flag-sandbox'.

 tom: try logging out and back in or run `rbx auth refresh` to refresh claims.

 alejandra: refreshed and now i can create a sandbox segment called sandbox-74123. thanks! one policy q: can i get prod-readonly to view audits for onboarding checks?

 security: prod-readonly + audit-log-view require the 15m audit-training and a short business justification. for onboarding please use staging audit logs. schedule training: internal/calendar/audit-training.

 alejandra: got it, will stick to staging and book the training. really appreciate the help :smile:
